fields.name: banana
fields.description: A tropical fruit crop rich in potassium and essential vitamins, grown in humid climates.
fields.care_tips: Requires regular watering, protection from strong winds, and mulching.
fields.pesticides: Imidacloprid for aphids, Carbofuran for nematodes, Beauveria bassiana for weevils

fields.name: barley
fields.description: A versatile cereal grain used for food, animal feed, and brewing beer, tolerant to dry climates.
fields.care_tips: Plant in well-drained soil, avoid excessive nitrogen.
fields.fertilizers: DAP at sowing (100kg/ha), Urea top dressing (50kg/ha)
fields.pesticides: Propiconazole for rust, Chlorpyrifos for aphids

fields.name: bittergourd
fields.description: A medicinal vegetable with a bitter taste, known for its benefits in managing blood sugar levels.
fields.care_tips: Needs trellising, regular harvesting encourages more fruit.
fields.pesticides: Neem oil for fruit flies, Spinosad for beetles

fields.name: blackgram
fields.description: A protein-rich legume widely used in South Asian cuisine, especially for dals and curries.
fields.care_tips: Drought tolerant but needs irrigation at flowering stage.
fields.pesticides: Carbendazim for root rot, Dimethoate for whiteflies

fields.name: blackpepper
fields.description: A highly prized spice known as the 'King of Spices', used globally for its pungent flavor.
fields.care_tips: Needs support trees, regular pruning essential.
fields.pesticides: Bordeaux mixture for quick wilt, Monocrotophos for pollu beetle

fields.name: bottlegourd
fields.description: A hydrating and low-calorie vegetable ideal for hot climates, often used in soups and stews.
fields.care_tips: Needs strong trellis, harvest when fruits are tender.
fields.pesticides: Carbaryl for fruit flies, Neem oil for aphids

fields.name: brinjal
fields.description: Also known as eggplant, this glossy purple vegetable is a staple in many global cuisines.
fields.care_tips: Staking prevents fruit rot, regular picking extends harvest.
fields.pesticides: Chlorantraniliprole for fruit borer, Imidacloprid for whiteflies

fields.name: cabbage
fields.description: A leafy green vegetable rich in vitamins K and C, used in salads, stir-fries and pickling.
fields.care_tips: Needs consistent moisture, avoid water stress.
fields.pesticides: Spinosad for diamondback moth, Bacillus thuringiensis for caterpillars

fields.name: cardamom
fields.description: A fragrant spice often called the 'Queen of Spices', used in desserts and aromatic dishes.
fields.care_tips: Requires shade (50-70%) and high humidity.
fields.fertilizers: 75:75:150 kg NPK/ha + 5kg neem cake per plant
fields.pesticides: Carbendazim for capsule rot, Quinalphos for shoot borer

fields.name: cauliflower
fields.description: A cruciferous vegetable known for its white florets, packed with antioxidants and fiber.
fields.care_tips: Blanching (tying leaves over curd) improves quality.
fields.pesticides: Malathion for aphids, Cypermethrin for caterpillars

fields.name: coriander
fields.description: A herb grown for both its leaves and seeds, offering distinct flavor and health benefits.
fields.care_tips: Quick-growing, successive planting ensures continuous harvest.
fields.pesticides: Neem oil for aphids, Carbendazim for powdery mildew

fields.name: cotton
fields.description: A major cash crop grown for its soft fibers used in textile manufacturing around the world.
fields.care_tips: Requires careful water management during boll formation.
fields.fertilizers: 60:30:30 kg NPK/ha + 5t FYM (adjust based on soil test)
fields.pesticides: Acephate for bollworms, Spiromesifen for whiteflies

fields.name: cucumber
fields.description: A refreshing, water-rich vegetable eaten raw in salads or juiced for hydration.
fields.care_tips: Trellising improves yield and reduces disease.
fields.pesticides: Carbaryl for beetles, Copper fungicide for downy mildew

fields.name: drumstick
fields.description: A nutrient-dense vegetable also known as moringa, praised for its medicinal properties.
fields.care_tips: Prune to 1m height to encourage branching.
fields.pesticides: Neem oil for leaf caterpillars, Carbofuran for root knot nematodes

fields.name: garlic
fields.description: A pungent bulbous plant used for seasoning and traditional medicine, rich in allicin.
fields.care_tips: Stop irrigation 2 weeks before harvest for better storage.
fields.pesticides: Mancozeb for purple blotch, Imidacloprid for thrips

fields.name: grapes
fields.description: A juicy fruit grown in clusters, consumed fresh or used in wine and juice production.
fields.care_tips: Pruning is critical for fruit production.
fields.pesticides: Sulfur for powdery mildew, Spinosad for berry moth

fields.name: horsegram
fields.description: A hardy legume known for its drought resistance and high iron and protein content.
fields.care_tips: Excellent for dryland farming, minimal inputs needed.
fields.pesticides: Seed treatment with Thiram for fungal diseases

fields.name: jackfruit
fields.description: A tropical fruit known for its large size and use as a meat substitute when unripe.
fields.care_tips: Space trees 10-12m apart, mulch heavily.
fields.pesticides: Monocrotophos for fruit borer, Copper oxychloride for stem rot

fields.name: jowar
fields.description: Also called sorghum, a drought-tolerant grain used to make flatbreads and porridge.
fields.care_tips: Very drought resistant, good for marginal soils.
fields.fertilizers: 80:40:40 kg NPK/ha (adjust N based on previous crop)
fields.pesticides: Endosulfan for shoot fly, Mancozeb for grain mold

fields.name: jute
fields.description: A fiber crop grown for making sacks, ropes, and eco-friendly textiles.
fields.care_tips: Retting process crucial for fiber quality.
fields.pesticides: Carbendazim for stem rot, Quinalphos for semilooper

fields.name: ladyfinger
fields.description: Also known as okra, this green pod vegetable is rich in fiber and essential nutrients.
fields.care_tips: Harvest pods when tender (4-5 days after flowering).
fields.pesticides: Neem oil for fruit borers, Carbendazim for yellow vein mosaic

fields.name: maize
fields.description: A globally important cereal crop used for food, feed, and industrial products.
fields.care_tips: Critical irrigation at tasseling and silking stages.
fields.pesticides: Atrazine for weeds, Carbaryl for stem borer

fields.name: mango
fields.description: The 'king of fruits', enjoyed for its sweet flavor and rich vitamin A and C content.
fields.care_tips: Prune after harvest, regulate flowering for consistent yields.
fields.pesticides: Carbaryl for fruit fly, Copper fungicide for anthracnose

fields.name: moong
fields.description: A highly nutritious legume used in soups and salads, known for its quick cooking and digestibility.
fields.care_tips: Short duration crop, good for intercropping.
fields.pesticides: Carbendazim for root rot, Dimethoate for whitefly

fields.name: onion
fields.description: A bulb crop with strong flavor, used as a base in countless recipes worldwide.
fields.care_tips: Stop irrigation when necks start softening before harvest.
fields.pesticides: Mancozeb for purple blotch, Chlorpyriphos for thrips

fields.name: orange
fields.description: A citrus fruit high in vitamin C, consumed fresh or as juice to boost immunity.
fields.care_tips: Requires micronutrients (Zn, Mn, Fe) for good yields.
fields.pesticides: Imidacloprid for citrus psylla, Copper fungicide for canker

fields.name: papaya
fields.description: A tropical fruit known for its digestive enzymes and antioxidant-rich orange flesh.
fields.care_tips: Plant both male and female trees for pollination.
fields.pesticides: Carbaryl for fruit fly, Metalaxyl for root rot

fields.name: pineapple
fields.description: A spiky tropical fruit with sweet and tart flesh, used in juices, desserts and cooking.
fields.care_tips: Ethylene treatment induces uniform flowering.
fields.pesticides: Chlorpyrifos for mealybugs, Mancozeb for fruit rot

fields.name: potato
fields.description: A root crop that serves as a global staple, used in countless forms from fries to curries.
fields.care_tips: Hilling up soil around plants increases tuber yield.
fields.pesticides: Mancozeb for late blight, Imidacloprid for aphids

fields.name: pumpkin
fields.description: A large orange fruit used in pies and soups, rich in beta-carotene and fiber.
fields.care_tips: Allow fruits to mature fully on vine for best flavor.
fields.pesticides: Carbaryl for fruit flies, Sulfur for powdery mildew

fields.name: radish
fields.description: A fast-growing root vegetable with a spicy crunch, eaten raw or cooked.
fields.care_tips: Quick maturing, successive planting possible.
fields.pesticides: Malathion for flea beetles, Chlorothalonil for leaf spot

fields.name: ragi
fields.description: Also called finger millet, a nutritious grain rich in calcium and used in traditional porridges.
fields.care_tips: Drought resistant, stores well for years.
fields.pesticides: Seed treatment with Thiram, Endosulfan for shoot fly

fields.name: rapeseed
fields.description: A bright yellow flowering plant grown for oil-rich seeds, processed into canola oil.
fields.care_tips: Critical irrigation at flowering and pod formation.
fields.pesticides: Carbendazim for white rust, Deltamethrin for aphids

fields.name: rice
fields.description: The most widely consumed staple food globally, grown in flooded paddies.
fields.care_tips: Requires consistent water supply, proper leveling of fields.
fields.pesticides: Carbofuran for stem borer, Tricyclazole for blast

fields.name: soyabean
fields.description: A protein-packed legume used in tofu, oil, and animal feed, vital in vegetarian diets.
fields.care_tips: Inoculate seeds with Bradyrhizobium for better N fixation.
fields.pesticides: Chlorpyriphos for girdle beetle, Carbendazim for yellow mosaic

fields.name: sunflower
fields.description: A tall crop grown for seeds that produce oil and snacks, also ornamental.
fields.care_tips: Critical irrigation at flowering and seed filling stages.
fields.pesticides: Imidacloprid for capitulum borer, Mancozeb for rust

fields.name: sweetpotato
fields.description: A nutritious tuber rich in fiber and beta-carotene, used in both sweet and savory dishes.
fields.care_tips: Vines root easily at nodes, can be propagated from cuttings.
fields.pesticides: Chlorpyriphos for weevils, Mancozeb for leaf spot

fields.name: tomato
fields.description: A juicy red fruit used in sauces, salads, and cooking, rich in lycopene.
fields.growing_season: Cool season in tropics, summer in temperate
fields.care_tips: Staking improves yield and reduces disease incidence.
fields.pesticides: Indoxacarb for fruit borer, Metalaxyl for late blight

fields.name: turmeric
fields.description: A golden-yellow root known for its anti-inflammatory properties and use in curries.
fields.care_tips: Rhizomes are boiled and dried before marketing.
fields.pesticides: Mancozeb for leaf blotch, Chlorpyriphos for shoot borer

fields.name: wheat
fields.description: A staple grain milled into flour, forming the basis of bread, pasta, and many baked goods.
fields.care_tips: Critical irrigation at crown root initiation and flowering.
fields.pesticides: Tebuconazole for rust, Chlorpyriphos for termites

fields.description: Standard carrot crop
